acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce on origin/main with -count=20 under load or show it does not reproduce; classify as load-sensitive (fold into V1-0849) or a real race (fix with a regression test).
A note records whether TestCALV0117's 581/582 checkpoint mismatch shares the cause.
body: Observed 2026-10-16 by the V1-1497 lane (PR #977 branch; Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.1, load average 52-102): internal/tasks/store TestCALV0089_IntegrateCheckpointRestartKeepsGrant failed at program_continuation_test.go:612. Not yet reproduced on origin/main alone, so this is a suspected defect: it may be load sensitivity (umbrella V1-0849) or a real checkpoint/grant race. The V1-1494 lane separately saw TestCALV0117_WriterAdvanceAndScheduledRefresh read checkpoint 581, want 582, possibly related. Expected: deterministic pass. Actual: intermittent failure.
title: tests (suspected): TestCALV0089_IntegrateCheckpointRestartKeepsGrant fails at program_continuation_test.go:612 under load
